name: example-agency-storefront
title: storefront page kind
description: A static retail storefront page kind: hero, one featured product, an optional short collection grid, optional product details, a required buy-or-preorder step whose destination is honest to the brief (a supplied URL, else phone, else email, else plain text), optional shipping and returns, optional reviews, optional story or about, and a footer. Fits a fashion label, single-SKU shop, hardware preorder or digital drop sold as goods. Composed from eleven vendored HyperUI blocks with Tailwind compiled once and inlined; no page kind JavaScript beyond the two reviewed GenUI effect placements.

query.en: Use the storefront family for a static fashion label, single-SKU shop or preorder drop mock: a hero, one featured product, an optional short collection grid, optional product details, a buy-or-preorder step, optional shipping and returns, optional reviews and an optional story or about. Ask for the business, its products and how a visitor buys or preorders, generate a schemaVersion 2 storefront typed recipe through the bundled trusted compiler, and render it. This is a page kind, not a decoded client site: every business fact in the reference fixture is a placeholder.
